# Wings - full agent context

> Block editor for nested pages with LaTeX, Excalidraw, a local vault folder, and BYOK AI. Private journal product on https://wings.nopejs.me

## Summary

Wings is a Vite SPA journal. Marketing pages and the blog are public. The app (`/app`, `/:username`), auth, checkout, and share links (`/s/`) are private or noindex. There is no public REST API for third parties. Auth is Supabase (Google OAuth + magic link PKCE). AI is bring-your-own-key in the browser. Local vault pages keep bodies on a connected folder; Wings stores the title so the sidebar still works.

## Crawler policy

robots.txt declares Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes. Training bots (GPTBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Bytespider) are Disallow. Search and citation bots remain allowed. User content routes stay Disallow.
